title: Fix these before you change the menu

slides.headline: Fix these three things before changing your menu
slides.sub: Most regulars leave over small friction, not the food.

slides.headline: Your queue is the first impression
slides.body: If the line is slow, nobody tastes the coffee. Time one busy hour and count the steps per order.

slides.headline: Say what is sold out, early
slides.body: A sign at the door beats a sorry at the till. People forgive a missing item, not a surprise.

slides.headline: Ask five regulars one question
slides.body: What almost made you go somewhere else this month? Write the answers down without arguing.

slides.label: is the longest anyone should wait for a simple order

slides.before: We need more items to bring people in.
slides.after: A shorter menu served faster brings people back.

slides.headline: Fix the small things first
slides.cta: Save this and send it to your team
